description: Declared repo-protection shape for this repo. Read by tools/validators/check_merge_queue.py (invariant guardrail) and tools/configure-repo-protection.ps1 (applies it via the GitHub API). The apply tool uses one branch ruleset for required checks + merge queue, then clears classic required_status_checks to avoid conflicts. Absent file => tooling is a no-op, so this is opt-in per repo. Copy preset/kerrigan/repo-protection.json to adopt the optimized Kerrigan default in another repo, then override fields for that repo's setup.
